column1: # PROMISE LEDGER FOR CONFIGURATION FORMS AND COMPOSITION

# Each row states either an externally published promise or an explicit current decision for one input coordinate. Promises are read only from website documentation and contract docblocks; implementation bodies determine neither promised forms nor status.
# The denominator is generated from registered rule-option keys, CLI aliases, framework keys, non-rule configuration paths, interacting key pairs, and source-composition coordinates.
# PROMISED rows have a cited carrier. DECIDED rows record behavior where no carrier promises it. DEFERRED rows name a deliberately excluded interaction whose current behavior remains measurable.
# Carrier ranges are protected by promise-ledger-frozen-ranges.tsv. When a carrier changes, affected rows and hashes must be regenerated together; silent divergence is a failure.

# Source precedence and coexistence are separate coordinates: a later source may replace a value while sibling paths survive. Pair rows record the promised winner, outcome, and survival independently.
# decided_forms contains the complement observed or deliberately fixed where the carrier does not close the input set. Notes preserve the local rationale and exact code or documentation evidence.
# Columns: kind, coordinate, promised forms or interaction contract, carrier, status, note, decided forms. The expanded header row below is authoritative for field positions.
